front.title: Source-IP-Origin-AS Filter for BGP Flow Specification

abstract.t: This document defines an extension to the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) Flow Specification Version 2 (FSv2) defined in [draft-ietf-idr- fsv2-ip-basic] to enable filtering based on the Origin Autonomous System (AS) of the source IP address. This extension is particularly useful in mitigating Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks where the source IP addresses are dynamic or numerous but belong to a specific source AS.
